questions.question: 下列圖形何者可判定該藥物具有非線性藥物動力學的特性？

options.A: Cmax vs. Dose: A straight line passing through the origin, indicating Cmax is directly proportional to the dose. This suggests linear pharmacokinetics.
options.B: Elimination half-life (t1/2) vs. Dose: A flat horizontal line, indicating that the half-life remains constant regardless of the dose. This is a characteristic of linear pharmacokinetics (first-order elimination).
options.C: AUC vs. Dose: A straight line passing through the origin, indicating that AUC is directly proportional to the dose. This suggests linear pharmacokinetics.
options.D: AUC/Dose vs. Dose: An upward sloping curve, indicating that as the dose increases, the AUC per unit dose also increases disproportionately. This is a hallmark of non-linear pharmacokinetics, often due to saturation of elimination processes (e.g., metabolism or transport).
